user.title: Update Guard
user.description: Update Guard reads the release notes of every pending update and compares them with your setup. It tells you what might break before you install, as a sensor and in Repairs.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Update Guard is already set up.

update_wait.title: Wait with {name} {latest}

update_check.title: Check before updating {name} {latest}

after_broken.title: After updating {names}, {count} stopped working

init.title: Settings
init.description: Notifications on your phone when a new update shows up, and an optional AI check of changelogs.

data_description.notify: One or more, e.g. notify.mobile_app_your_phone. Leave empty for no notifications.
data_description.ai_task: An AI Task entity, e.g. Google Gemini. It double-checks lines found by keywords in app, HACS and firmware changelogs and drops false alarms. Only those lines and the names of your options and devices are sent – never values. Leave empty to not use AI.

options.check: Only updates that need a look (check, wait or unknown)
